messages:
emma (PM): Post-launch quick split: which items are hotpatch candidates vs backlog? Saw dropdown state bug and embeddings 95p latency spike. Errors +3.8% and +18 support tickets. Thoughts?

noah (Support): Dropdown resets on reload ~11 tickets, mostly Safari. Users call it confusing; flagged P1.

raj (Eng): I reproduced. Client-side state key not persisted. Small fix: write to localStorage + guard on read. Estimate 2h dev + 1 QA.

emma (PM): Sounds patchable. Any revenue impact for latency?

carla (Data): Embeddings 95p spiking to ~1.2s for 3 enterprise customers; 7 related incidents in 72h. Estimated ~$2k/day exposure.

lisa (Eng): Root cause seems batching window expansion during bursts; queue backs up while autoscaler spins up. Could be config or scaling policy. Needs backend work and canary. Not trivial but high impact.

sophia (Design): For dropdown I can add a visible selected-state fallback so users at least see the choice before reload. Quick CSS + animation, ~1.5h. Happy to pair with Raj.

emma (PM): Proposed rule for this patch: auto-fix client UI regressions and anything with >8 tickets OR >=1% revenue impact. All other feature asks go to backlog unless championed with mock. Agree?

raj (Eng): Agree. I'll take dropdown fix today. Will add unit test and small e2e. ETA: EOD.

lisa (Eng): I'll run a limited canary: reduce batching window to 10ms for affected enterprise route for 30m, monitor 95p and queue length. If latency improves, plan rollout + tweak autoscale aggressiveness. Need approval to deploy canary today during low traffic.

carla (Data): I'll configure dashboard alert: embeddings 95p >800ms for 10m => page #eng-runtime and flag customers. I'll also surface canary metrics to this channel.

noah (Support): I'll update tickets and send a short note to impacted customers that we're testing a fix and monitoring.

emma (PM): Action items: Raj + Sophia: dropdown fix (patch). Lisa: embeddings canary + rollback plan. Carla: alert + dashboards. Noah: customer comms. Quick sync tomorrow 10:30 PT to review canary.
